name: Umeshu
description: Green ume steeped in spirit and sugar for months — sweet, sour and strong.

tcm.note: Read with the fruit liqueurs; alcohol is warming.

ayurveda.note: Madya is ushna in a high degree.

histamine.note: Alcohol plus months of steeping on sour fruit — both mechanisms.

effects.note: Alcohol measurably slows reaction time and narrows attention at ordinary drinking doses, well before intoxication feels subjectively obvious — one of the most consistently replicated findings in pharmacology, and the reason legal drink-driving limits exist at all. A small glass, sweet and easy to underestimate, still delivers enough to produce it. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
